adjudication.rationale: The diff adds `resources :embeddable_hosts` in `config/routes.rb`, which by default creates index/show routes (`GET /admin/embeddable_hosts`, `GET /admin/embeddable_hosts/:id`). The new `Admin::EmbeddableHostsController` only defines `create`, `update`, and `destroy`, so hitting those generated GET routes would raise `ActionNotFound`/404. However, the UI added in this diff appears to fetch hosts via `Admin::EmbeddingController#show` (`/admin/customize/embedding`) and only uses POST/PUT/DELETE for `embeddable_hosts`, so this is more an unnecessary/overbroad route exposure than a demonstrated broken behavior in the diff.
